data.one_liner: A versatile Flutter widget for rendering interactive and customized pie charts.
data.what_it_does: The package offers a pie chart widget with three variants: Crust, TriCrust, and Fill. It provides interactive pie slices that respond to user taps, along with options for gaps, custom start angles, animations, and center text.
use_when: You need to display simple pie charts or donut charts in your Flutter application.
You require interactive pie slices with tap callbacks.
avoid_when: You need complex multi-series charts, line charts, or bar charts.
strengths: Multiple pie chart variants (Crust, TriCrust, Fill)
Interactive pie slices with tap support
